# SecureLayer

> Freelance cybersecurity services — landing page and service catalogue.

SecureLayer is an independent freelance cybersecurity operator. This website is an informational landing page presenting the service catalogue (Application Security, SecDevOps, IT Security, AI Security, security advice) and links to social media. It does not provide any interactive tool, download, or service directly through the site.

## Contact

- Website: https://securelayer.co
- Social: Bluesky, Instagram, GitHub (see site footer/dock for links)
